options.detail: Git 2.48.0 date grammar accepts calendar/ISO/RFC-style times, explicit epoch-second raw dates with timezone, and relative expressions such as '2 weeks ago'. Unzoned calendar values use local time; relative values use the current wall clock. Bare numerals are heuristic: values >=100000000 can be treated as epoch seconds while smaller values can be calendar fields; they are not uniformly seconds or milliseconds. Use an explicit unambiguous date/expression. Use a zero cutoff, preventing ordinary expiry by age Use TIME_MAX as the cutoff, imposing no additional age restriction Reference scope: Git 2.48.0.
